bodyHtml: Many of you know that I am a big fan of activity tracking devices like FitBit and Jawbone.  The new Apple Watch is exciting also! I have a FitBit myself and use it every day.  If you have one too, join our group – Curry Losers! We give away a $50 eStore gift certificate each month to the one who has the most steps! Dr. Curry
